name: Disneyland Tiana's Palace House-Filled Beignet (Lemon Ice Box Pie Filling — Citrus Warning!)
brandOrRestaurant: Tiana's Palace (New Orleans Square · Disneyland Park)

prepOrOrderInstructions: Skip Tiana's Lemon-Filled Beignet completely and walk next door to the Mint Julep Bar window for plain Powdered-Sugar Mickey Beignets instead.
